name: Dull Deer 65
author: shadowfax29
description: Neon rounded sky-blue toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #2196F3 to #000000, border-radius becomes 50px, box-shadow becomes inset 9px 0px 1px 0px #ffffff. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 1px #2196F3.
